analysis.rationale: pair0 signals: mean_shift=-36.3, variance_ratio=0.657, clipped_fraction=0.494, block_boundary=0.994, noise_prior_sigma=0.74. brightness_darken_shfit_RGB:3 reproduces target mean_shift (-36.0 vs -36.3; additive shift attenuated by 49% zero-clipping), variance_ratio (0.664 vs 0.657), zero-clipping (diff 0.15pp) and unique_RGB (diff 0) exactly; HSV variants (25.2/27.0dB), sev2 (27.68dB) and sev4 (26.23dB) rejected. Mild blur recovered from residual gm_ratio/spectral slope: gaussian:2 adds +2.18dB over brightness-only (34.62->36.80), peak vs sev1 36.50/sev3 36.18. Excluded: JPEG (block_boundary 0.994<1.05; adding JPEG drops to 34.2-35.5dB), noise (sigma 0.74; peeled extreme_pct=75.5% is the documented >50%+sigma<5 false positive), contrast (weaken sev1 -> 18.46dB on pair1), saturation (chroma_ratio=1.053). Pair0 final PSNR 36.80dB is deterministic but in the 30-40dB band -> UNCERTAIN per verdict rules. Cross-pair verification (same pipeline): pair0 36.80/8-10, pair1 19.96/5-10, pair2 30.07/9-10, pair3 28.34/8-10, pair4 25.65/8-10. All five pairs independently flag BRIGHTNESS_darken_sev3 and brightness tone fit generalizes; pair1 (dense line-art) is a content-sensitive outlier where lens:2 scores marginally better (20.03, CI 9/10). Blur kernel/severity remain ambiguous -> overall UNCERTAIN, training PSNR to arbitrate.
